    Easy for only one of us

    Flight hours are estimates of nonstop flying time from the main airport, worked out from distance. Real trips with a connection take longer. Visa rules change; always confirm on the destination's official immigration site before booking. "Update the lists" asks Claude to re-check every row from what it knows. It can't browse the web, so treat changes it flags as leads to verify.

    Travel times

    How long does each of us fly?

    Each of you has your own route: where you start, an optional connection, the place you meet, and where you each fly afterwards (the same place or different ones). Times are flying estimates from distance, with 2.5 hours added for each connection. Use "Check flights" on any leg to see real options.

      Flight scanner

      Scan fares for both of us

      Set where you meet and your dates. The scanner builds searches for every flight on Google Flights, Skyscanner and Kayak, across a few days either side, so you can spot the cheapest day. Log the prices you find, and the board keeps the best one for each flight and shows how prices move.

      Log a price you found

      Best prices so far

      Itinerary

      Our day-by-day plan

      Add activities to each day and slide to set how long each one takes. The coloured bar shows how full the day is, and "Line up times" spaces things out for you. Changes save for both of you.

      Weather for your trip dates

      Typical conditions for your exact dates at each shortlisted place, from long-term climate averages. Change the dates on the Discover overview and everything here updates. Tap a place to see it day by day.

      Things to do

      What to do at each shortlisted place

      Pick a place from your shortlist. You'll see where to stay and the top picks, then the full list of things to do in the city, day trips, tours and activities like cruises and kayaking, and the main attractions.

      Hotels and resorts

      Where to stay

      Example places at three price levels, with typical February prices per night for a double room in US dollars. Check live prices on a booking site; February is peak season in most of these places.

      Price outlook

      What February will likely cost

      Typical return fares and hotel prices for February, how much pressure the season puts on them, and when to book. These are estimates from usual patterns, not live fares.

      Estimated trip cost for two, 7 nights, mid-range

      Ask for a fresh outlook

      Pick a destination and ask for fare tips and booking timing.

      Budget

      Plan the trip budget

      Start from the estimates for a destination, then change any number. The plan is saved for both of you, and the expense tracker compares your spending against it.

      Money

      Track what we spend

      Log each expense with who paid and how to split it. The board keeps a running total against your budget and works out who owes whom.
